claims.claim_text: Conventional 4-koma structure follows ki-shō-ten-ketsu: setup (ki), development (shō), twist/turn (ten), and conclusion (ketsu) across equal vertical panels.

Long-scroll vertical layouts replace page-turns with inter-panel whitespace intervals to govern reading cadence and dramatic reveals.

claims.claim_text: External Compositional Structure (page grid/layout) is structurally distinct and independent from Internal Compositional Structure (panel content).
A tall panel beside a stack of smaller panels creates blockage, redirecting the reader's path downward before advancing horizontally.
Slanted boundaries and oblique cuts induce visual velocity and psychological instability in high-tempo action scenes.

Panels devoid of text create a contemplative pause, compressing attention and decelerating subjective narrative time.

failure_modes: Reader confusing past memory with present real-time sequence
